headline: Ayar Labs Wins Demo of the Year Award at 2026 TSMC North America Technology Symposium
summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., November 10, 2026--Ayar Labs, the leader in optical interconnect solutions for AI scale-up, won the Demo of the Year Award at the 2026 TSMC North America Technology Symposium, in Santa Clara, California. The award is presented annually to the most popular demo, as chosen by visitors to the "Innovate with TSMC!" Demo Zone—a platform showcasing innovations from TSMC’s emerging customers at the Technology Symposium.
